No chokepoints. Seamless Interoperability Best of breed. API-first framework. Why AppGate? AppGate outperforms typical cloud-routed ZTNA solutions solving the real challenges associated with access control, network complexity and risk. Enable Fast, Secure Access in Dynamic Environments Provide fast, reliable, and protected connectivity for users wherever they are, adapting seamlessly to changing network conditions, device types, and access requirements without sacrificing security or performance. Reduce Network Complexity and Cost Simplify network architecture by eliminating unnecessary hardware and routing inefficiencies, lowering OpEx while maintaining robust security and streamlined management across distributed environments. Enhance End User Productivity Empower employees and partners with seamless, secure access to critical applications and resources, minimizing connection delays and disruptions while delivering a consistent UX to enhance business productivity. Achieve Compliance with Evolving Regulations Stay ahead of shifting regulations and standards with adaptable security controls, providing continuous visibility and auditability to ensure compliance across all industry verticals. Faster, Leaner and More Cost-Efficient ZTNA AppGate ZTNA cuts through cost and complexity by eliminating legacy hardware, consolidating tools, and streamlining access into one high-performance platform.
